description: Headless Renovate (no PR workflow; preset: homelab/default.json). It watches go.mod and the workflow's actions. A new version lands on main as a commit and the CI builds, vets, tests and lints it; nutrak and vimmary receive it when they raise their meltkit requirement.

packageRules.description: A release is three days old before it is taken, so a broken release is usually withdrawn or fixed before it reaches main. The CI tests the commit after it landed; the undo is a revert of the commit.

go.mod and go.sum are shared by every module update; one branch for all non-major updates writes them once instead of producing branches that conflict with each other. The go directive is excluded by the preset's own rule and moves alone.
